subject: Compact POC recap & reference ask (Cumulus Retail)
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@cumulusretail.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@cumulusretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Compact POC recap & reference ask

Hi Jamie / Olivia,

Thanks again for running the week-long POC with Redwood — the engineers on both sides were great to work with. I attached a 2-page metrics snapshot from our run (cumulus_poc_metrics_20261110.pdf) that summarizes the key outcomes you flagged during the debrief. High level: 

- Average inference latency (tail P95): 42 ms (across 32k tokens/day workload)
- Cost per 1k generated tokens: ~$0.38 after batching and prefix caching
- Throughput improvement vs your baseline: 3.1x
- Error rate (failed requests): 0.4%

We'd love to include a very short customer blurb in our case materials — just one or two sentences that we can attribute to Cumulus Retail. Example ask: a 1–2 line quote about the impact or a quick 15-minute reference call. If you prefer we can send a single-sentence template to make it easier.

If helpful, proposed next steps:
1) Quick confirmation of whether a one-line quote is okay (we’ll draft it for your sign‑off)
2) Optional 15-min call this week to capture a soundbite and agree on attribution

Available times I can propose: Thu 11/12 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 11/13 14:00–15:00 PT.

Appreciate it — we loved partnering with you on this.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: cumulus_poc_metrics_20261110.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
From: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@cumulusretail.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@cumulusretail.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compact POC recap & reference ask

Hi Mina — thanks for the clear recap and the PDF. The team reviewed and the numbers line up with what we observed. Happy to provide a short blurb and a quick call.

Here’s a one-liner you can use as a starting point (feel free to edit for length):
"Redwood’s serving runtime reduced our inference latency by more than 3x while giving us predictable cost and a simple rollout path."

We’re open to a 15-minute call — Thu 11/12 at 10:30 PT works for me if that slot is still open.

Two small asks: please don’t publish the per-token cost in public-facing materials (we’ll share that privately in the case study doc), and list the contact as Cumulus Retail — Engineering, not an individual contributor.

—Jamie
Jamie Ortiz
Head of Engineering, Cumulus Retail
jamie.ortiz@cumulusretail.com
Attachment: cumulus_one_line_quote.txt (text, 1 line)
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@cumulusretail.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@cumulusretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compact POC recap & reference ask

Thanks Jamie — really appreciate the quick turnaround and the sentence. We’ll honor the request to keep per-token pricing internal.

Marissa / Rishi / Marcus — looping you in to shepherd the one-line into our references/website workflow and to confirm the planned attribution: 
- Attribution: "Cumulus Retail — Engineering" (company-level)
- Use: case study landing, customer quote callout, and sales one-pager

Marissa: can your team post-edit the line for flow and send back a final draft to Jamie for sign-off? I’ll slot the 11/12 10:30 PT call on my calendar in the meantime.

Jamie / Olivia: if you prefer not to join the call, we can capture audio and send the final draft for an approval email.

Thanks all,
Mina

[Signature omitted in thread for brevity]
From: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@cumulusretail.com>

Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@cumulusretail.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compact POC recap & reference ask

Mina / Marissa — good to go. Marissa, feel free to tighten the language but please remove the explicit cost figure from any public quote. I’m attaching a signed consent PDF for our records (cumulus_reference_consent.pdf).

Final approved blurb: 
"Cumulus Retail — Engineering: Redwood reduced inference latency by over 3x and provided a straightforward path to production, which helped us accelerate our checkout personalization rollout."

You have permission to use that quote and to list attribution as Cumulus Retail — Engineering. Thanks for making the pilot low overhead.

—Jamie

Attachment: cumulus_reference_consent.pdf (PDF, signed)
